comment: The frames after a cold start's Ready come at the display's rate. A shot run clears the settings directory, so this is the cold start. The Brush Presets docker's grid is bound by the boot's scan in shares, so a change of the icon size lets every cell go and the report straight after it says `building` is every cell listed. A search typed the next frame answers from the cells built by then: `visible` is the matches at once and `building` the matches never built. Thirty frames on, with the search cleared, `building` is nought and every cell is in the grid in order, which the second shot shows.
